PIETY_COUNT.title: Piety
PIETY_COUNT.description: Your current Piety ({PietyIcon}) count. The Devout gains {PietyIcon} when she gains HP on her turn. The Devout's cards may require {PietyIcon} to play.
PENANCE_COUNT.title: Penance
PENANCE_COUNT.description: Your current Penance ({PenanceIcon}) count. The Devout gains {PenanceIcon} when she loses HP on her turn. The Devout's cards may require {PenanceIcon} to play.
DEVOUT-UNSHEATHE.title: Unsheathed
DEVOUT-UNSHEATHE.description:
Angur must be drawn from the Ophanic Wheel to be wielded.

Angur has [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
When it is played with a 0{singleEnergyIcon} cost, it [gold]Exhausts[/gold]. Otherwise, it returns to the [gold]Hand[/gold].
DEVOUT-FLIP.title: Flip
DEVOUT-FLIP.smartDescription: When played, this card is returned to the [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Transformed[/gold] to its other side, [blue]{Card}[/blue].
DEVOUT-FLIP.description: When played, this card is returned to the [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Transformed[/gold] to its other side, [blue]{Card}[/blue].
DEVOUT-PERFORMANCE.title: Performance
DEVOUT-PERFORMANCE.description:
Angur may be wielded to [gold]Perform[/gold] a [purple]Technique[/purple].

A [purple]Technique[/purple] is an enchantment placed upon Angur, which is removed upon play.

The [purple]Technique[/purple] card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], and any modifiers granted to it by other enchantments are transferred to [gold]Angur[/gold].
DEVOUT-COUP_DE_GRACE.title: Coup de Grâce
DEVOUT-COUP_DE_GRACE.description: This card costs [blue]1[/blue] less {singleEnergyIcon} for each time Angur has been played this turn.
